item: Amyl Nitrate/Poppers: chi-square stars (0 = none printed)

The paper prints no star for any of them. Sparse cells do not explain it: the minimum expected count is 8-10 for DMT/Salvia/Ayahuasca/Mescaline and 6.2 for ketamine, and alcohol (minimum expected 2.9) is starred. Omission, not a different test. The Results text also lists only alcohol, marijuana, LSD, MDMA, cocaine and poppers as significant, omitting cigarettes, which the table does star.
